recipes.name: Creamy PHILADELPHIA® Pasta Primavera
ingredients_raw: 2 tablespoons KRAFT Light Zesty Italian Dressing
1.5 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch chunks
4 ounces PHILADELPHIA 1/3 Less Fat Cream Cheese, cubed

steps.text: Cook pasta as directed on package.

Meanwhile, heat dressing in large skillet on medium heat. Add chicken and vegetables; cook 10 to 12 min. or until chicken is cooked through, stirring frequently. Add broth and cream cheese; cook 1 min. or until cheese is melted, stirring constantly. Add Parmesan cheese; mix well.
Drain pasta; return to pot. Add chicken and vegetable mixture; toss lightly. Cook 1 min. or until heated through. (Sauce will thicken upon standing.)

raw_recipe.headline: Creamy PHILADELPHIA® Pasta Primavera
raw_recipe.description: Penne pasta is combined with boneless chicken breast, red bell pepper, fresh asparagus, and zucchini in a cream sauce.

review.reviewBody: My husband (who is a picky eater!) and I loved this meal! It was so quick and easy. I didn't have any fresh veggies on hand, so I used a frozen stir fry mix instead. Highly recommend this!

This was really quite good (better than I expected) and it could not be easier! I used every vegetable I had in my fridge. I put onions and bell pepper in with the chicken. Then added mushrooms, zucchini, and asparagus when I added the cream cheese to keep them from getting mushy. You could easily make zucchini noodles to replace the pasta. I will definitely make this again.

This is a great starter recipe. I used yellow pepper, red pepper, zucchini, and asparagus. I added red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper to the sauce. I added butter to the noodles. I also used thin spaghetti. Turned out delicious!

I used what chicken I had on hand, 3 boneless skinless thighs and 2 breasts. Seasoned well with salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika, Italian seasoning and mixed well with greek yogurt. Seared the chicken alone with just olive oil (before cutting) and removed them when they were almost done. I then added the veggies (with garlic and a diced onion) I made my own dressing consisting of olive oil, lemon zest, juice of half a lemon, splash of maple syrup, a tsp of Dijon mustard, salt, pepper, garlic powder, red pepper flakes. I added the dressing in with the veggies, then diced the chicken and added it in after a few mins. I also used Cavatappi pasta, just a preference. It turned out delicious!!

This is so easy! It only took 30 minutes and i used things I already had in my fridge/pantry. I substituted broccoli, green onions and carrots. I added a bit more Italian dressing to pump up the flavor. I will definitely make this again!

This was delicious, I could have eaten the whole thing all by my self. I added broccoli florets instead of the asparagus and added yellow squash besides the zucchini. I probably could make this at least once a week.

This made a great weeknight meal! I did marinate my chicken in my italian dressing for about 4 hours! Turned out fantastic very flavorful! I did add a whole block of cream cheese i figured why not lol go big or go home lol and added some parmasan cheese absolutely Delish!!

This recipe is a keeper with a few alterations. I agree with using more Italian dressing, I used 3 tbs & it was fine. I did add carrots, red onion, mushrooms, &peas, in addition to the called for vegetables(we're vege people). When I make this again I will use only 1/2 - 3/4 cup of broth since the sauce did not thicken much. Heating thru will take closer to 5 minutes(mine was lukewarm after heating for 2 minutes). Crusty bread on the side will go nice with this dish

Created a vegetarian version, omitted the chicken and used vegetable broth instead of chicken broth. I also add carrots and green onion along with a seasoning mix with a lot of black pepper. It was very easy to make and I will make again!
This was yummy! We decided it would also be good without the pasta and replaced the pasta with some yellow crookneck squash. It turned out delicious.

I followed this recipe almost verbatim but had to improvise the vegetables, so Instead of the ones called for I used brocoli and carrots as that is all I had on hand. Turned out very good but feel the sauce was missing something in the way of spice maybe, and felt it needed a kick of some sort. would definitely make it again but with the suggested vegetables.
Won't make again....way too "blah"/boring. I can appreciate the healthy factor of it.
I added a few ingredients but otherwise, this recipe was very delicious on it's own.
This is a quick delicious dinner that my family loves! I use whatever vegetables I have available. Highly recommend!

Excellent recipe. My kids, who are fussiest eaters EVER ate it all up. I added more pasta than the recipe asked for and I skipped the zucchini and asparagus. I also added more cream cheese.

I added pink Himalayan salt and pepper and it turned out great.
It was easy and super tasty. Added broccoli and garlic and used a bit more cream cheese than called for.
Was chicken and noodles per my husband, good but not as good as my homemade egg noodles with chicken and broth.
Made as written but without the chicken. Yummy and easy. I made a mistake and bought herb and chive cream cheese. And it was so good!!
Yum! And pretty easy too. I added way more cheese. Parmesan, romano, and asiago. It tastes like heaven!
